hook: Agar Chand Aadhi Doori Pe Aa Jaye Toh?

points.title: Aasmaan mein bada Chand
points.text: Chand do guna chauda aur lagbhag 4 guna zyada chamkila dikhega.

points.title: Tides 8 guna taakatwar
points.text: Chand ka tidal khinchaav 8 guna ho jayega. Samundar ki lehrein kai guna oonchi.

points.title: Mahina sirf 10 din
points.text: Chand Earth ka ek chakkar 27 nahi, lagbhag 10 din mein lagayega.

takeaway: Bas doori aadhi, aur poori duniya ulat-pulat!
